en: The Question on Transferring to Another Body.
"Venerable Nāgasena, is there any being who transmigrates from this body to another body?
“If, venerable Nāgasena, there is no passing over from this body to another body, will one not then be released from evil deeds?

“Yes, great king, if there were no rebirth-linking, one would indeed be released from evil deeds; but because, great king, there is rebirth-linking, therefore one is not fully released from evil deeds.
“Great King, suppose a certain man were to steal another man’s mangoes; would he deserve punishment?
“Yes, venerable sir, he would deserve punishment.
“But Great King, he did not steal those mangoes that were planted by him; why then would he deserve punishment?”
“Venerable sir, those mangoes grew depending upon those [original trees]; therefore, one would be subject to punishment.

“In the same way, great king, it is by means of this name-and-form that one performs wholesome or unwholesome karma; through that karma, another name-and-form is reborn. Therefore, one is not released from evil deeds.
The seventh question: On Transferring to Another Body.
